verse.verse_1: By the night when it enshrouds,
verse.verse_2: and by the day when it breaks in its glory,
verse.verse_3: and by Him Who created the male and the female:
verse.verse_5: As for him who gave out his wealth (for Allah's sake) and abstained (from disobeying Him),
verse.verse_6: and affirmed the Truth of goodness:
verse.verse_7: We shall facilitate for him the Way to Bliss.
verse.verse_8: As for him who was a miser and behaved with aversion (to Allah),
verse.verse_9: and denied the Truth of goodness:
verse.verse_10: We shall facilitate for him the way to Hardship,
verse.verse_11: and his wealth shall be of no avail to him when he perishes.
verse.verse_12: Surely it is for Us to show the Right Way,
verse.verse_13: and to Us belong the Next Life and the present.
verse.verse_14: I have now warned you of a Blazing Fire,
verse.verse_15: where none shall burn except the most wicked,
verse.verse_16: who rejected the Truth, calling it falsehood and turned his back on it.
verse.verse_17: But the God-fearing shall be kept away from it,
verse.verse_18: the Godfearing who spends his wealth to purify himself;
verse.verse_19: not as payment for any favours that he received,
verse.verse_20: but only to seek the good pleasure of his Lord Most High.
verse.verse_21: He will surely be well-pleased (with him).
